title: Tenancy agreement capture
description: Capture agreed rent, advance deposit, billing cycle day, and move-in date. Move-in date must support past dates for onboarding an already-resident tenant.
acceptanceCriteria: Move-in date accepts past dates without validation errors
Agreement is linked to exactly one bed

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Starting LODGY-12 and LODGY-13 together - AC3 here ('linked to exactly one bed') and LODGY-13's whole premise (assigning during onboarding flips the bed) are two halves of one atomic save, and DESIGN.md's onboarding flow is one continuous wizard (pick bed -> profile -> agreement) anyway. Building: vacant-bed picker (scoped to the currently active hostel, only ever lists VACANT beds so an occupied one is structurally unselectable) -> wired as the real 'Add Tenant' entry point ahead of LODGY-11's profile form -> agreement form -> save creates the TenancyAgreement and flips the bed to OCCUPIED in one action. Editing an existing tenant's profile still skips the bed picker entirely.

Full wizard wired: Tenants tab '+' -> BedPickerScreen (grouped by floor, only VACANT beds ever queried) -> TenantFormScreen (bedId carried as a nav arg) -> on save, TenantFormScreen now reports back the saved tenant's id (fixed a gap where it only reported 'done', not which tenant) -> AgreementFormScreen (rent/deposit/billing-day/move-in-date) -> save creates the TenancyAgreement AND calls bedRepository.setOccupied in the same action, then pops the whole wizard stack back to the Tenants tab. AC1: move-in date uses Material3's DatePicker with no selectableDates restriction, so past dates are accepted with no validation error. AC2: billingCycleDay is a numeric field validated to 1-28 inline (error state + helper text), Save disabled until valid. AC3: TenancyAgreement.bedId is a required non-null field on the entity already (LODGY-2), and this screen is only reachable with a bedId in hand. Editing an existing tenant (from the profile screen) still bypasses the picker entirely and goes straight to the plain form. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. On-device pass (especially clicking through the full 4-screen wizard) still queued behind the emulator boot.

PASS - all three AC confirmed on-device across two full onboarding runs. AC1: opened the date picker and selected Sept 1 (a date before "today", Sept 3) as move-in date - accepted with no error. AC2: typed billing cycle day 31 - field and helper text turned red ("1-28, so it stays valid every month") and Save & Move In disabled; corrected to 5/10 for the two tenants and it re-enabled. AC3: both agreements only ever reachable via the bed-picker flow (Room 101/Bed A for Ravi, Room 102/Bed A for Priya) - no way to reach the agreement form without a bed already chosen, and both beds correctly flipped to OCCUPIED on save.
